methodology: Built from 12 of 13 listed 'Statistical bulletin' documents (1 skipped). Million KZT, STATE budget (republican plus local), YEAR-TO-DATE CUMULATIVE -- resets each January, so a January value is not a collapse from the previous December. Read from column 5 of sheet 'табл 3'; the existing annual series of the same name reads column 3 of the same sheet. The deficit excluding oil revenue -- -5,037,288 mln KZT for January-June 2026 against a headline deficit of -2,275,950. The gap between the two is what oil contributed to the budget, and it is the number that shows the underlying fiscal position.
